Located at Unit L1-11, 12 & 21 on Level 1 of Saigon Centre, this is the first Louis Vuitton men’s store in Vietnam.

Evoking a distinctly masculine elegance, the space is defined by a sophisticated color palette, anchored by bold wood finishes that mirror the modern architectural language of the House’s latest men’s collections. Clients are immersed in the men’s universe, where they can discover a curated selection of the latest men’s ready-to-wear, leather goods, shoes, accessories, and travel collections.

At The Hour Glass, the mission is to advance the appreciation of watch culture. Renowned for the immersive retail experiences and passionate team of watch specialists, The Hour Glass aims to be the trusted destination for enthusiasts and collectors alike.

The Hour Glass Vietnam is proud to represent a curated portfolio of distinguished watchmaking houses, including Rolex, Tudor, Hublot, Girard-Perregaux, Ulysse Nardin, Zenith, Bvlgari, Cartier, Grand Seiko. With a network of 70 boutiques across the Asia Pacific, The Hour Glass remains dedicated to deepening your understanding of fine watchmaking and guiding you toward your next exceptional piece.

World-renowned for its hand-finished and contemporary jewelry at affordable prices, PANDORA designs, manufactures and markets jewelry made from high-quality materials. Founded in 1982 and headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, PANDORA is a universe of jewelry that offers vast of opportunities for personal expression. Consistently designed from our strong brand DNA, Pandora offers a wealth of charms, bracelets, rings, earrings, necklaces and pendants, allowing women to express their unique personal style.

storeDescription.markup:
Đoạn giới thiệu thương hiệu bằng tiếng Anh (tối đa 100 từ) Levi's® is a pioneer in the field of denim fashion. On May 20, 1873, founders Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis made history when they were granted a patent for the first blue jeans with legendary rivets, which were later named Levi's® 501® jeans. The year 2026 marks the 153rd anniversary of 501 Day - the day the first Levi's® 501® jeans were launched.

In Vietnam, Levi's® is exclusively distributed by ACFC. We have 56 stores spread across 13 provinces and cities nationwide: Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Hue, Da Nang, Can Tho, Nha Trang, Hai Phong, Quang Ninh, Binh Duong, Dong Nai, Vung Tau, An Giang, and Ca Mau.

We have over 25 million global followers on the Levi's VN fanpage.

TUDOR is a Swiss made watch brand, offering mechanical watches with sophisticated style, superior quality, and unique value for money. The origins of the TUDOR brand date back to 1926, when ‘The Tudor’ was first registered on behalf of Hans Wilsdorf. Over the course of history, TUDOR watches became the choice of daring individuals worldwide on land, ice, in the air and underwater.

Jo Malone London is a British fragrance and lifestyle brand known for the refined, minimalist elegance. From Eau de Toilette, Eau de Parfum, Absolu fragrances to scented home and body care, Jo Malone London offers a curated selection of exquisite notes and bespoke fragrance services for unique self-expression through scent.

Chang Kang Kung is famous as a restaurant specializing in providing fresh, clean food, high nutritional content, ensuring food hygiene, while maintaining the original taste, without using many marinated spices. In particular, the technology of hydrothermal steaming cooked food with steam and enjoy meals at the table after the food cooking to preserve the food is to help keeping 100% vitamins and minerals.

Since 1847, Cartier has expressed its creative vision through heritage, culture, and the pursuit of beauty. This spirit is reflected in the Maison’s watchmaking, where design and technical mastery come together in refined harmony. From the creation of the iconic Cartier Santos in 1904—one of the world’s first modern wristwatches—to the legendary Cartier Tank in 1917, Cartier has continuously redefined the language of time.

Today, contemporary icons such as Cartier Ballon Bleu and Cartier Panthère embody the Maison’s seamless fusion of jewellery artistry and horological excellence, creating timepieces that transcend function to become enduring symbols of elegance.

storeDescription.markup: At a glance, every watch—whether from the Sport, Heritage or Elegance Collection—is recognizably Grand Seiko. Why is this? The answer lies in the unique aesthetic of Grand Seiko and in its very Japanese sense of natural beauty. At the heart of this aesthetic is the Japanese reverence for the way that light paints an ever-changing and subtle picture of our world. The Japanese sensibility delights in the interplay of light, shadow, and darkness, and the myriad gradations they form. Every Grand Seiko design fully embraces the harmony of light, dark, and shadow.

Founded in 1865 by Georges Favre-Jacot, who revolutionized the way of producing timepieces. Zenith is the first watch company with a manufacture that hours all aspects of watchmaking under one roof. It is also the first brand to have developed, in 1969, a high-frequency automatic integrated column-wheel chronograph powered by the legendary EL Primero movement beating at 36,000 vibrations per hour.

Official Agribank agent providing foreign exchange and top-rated travel SIMs in Vietnam 2025; trusted, transparent, and efficient.

Currency exchange and SIM card services with reliability, speed, and transparency. Delivering convenient experiences and superior quality to meet all customer needs.

ALDO is the first and only Canadian retailer to achieve major market penetration in the United States. At the end of 2015, there were over 1,450 ALDO stores in over 95 countries, include 13 specialty stores in Vietnam, making it the world’s leading fashion footwear brand in terms of global reach. ALDO is the worldwide destination for on-trend fashion footwear and accessories at accessible prices. Positive, authentic, and bursting with personality, ALDO is the lifestyle brand for people stepping up in the world.
Annacoco is the multi-fashion sellect shop which introducesKorean contemporary fashion clothing and accessories. We aim to satisfy Vietnam trend setters with our sellected collection.

ASICS is a leading sports brand from Japan with over 50 years of experience in researching and developing footwear and sportswear. Present at Saigon Centre since 2018, ASICS has been bringing high-performance products to the sports community – especially running enthusiasts – through advanced technology and deep understanding of customer needs. The brand is committed to inspiring an active and balanced lifestyle, harmonizing mind, body, and spirit, in line with its philosophy: “Sound Mind, Sound Body” (Anima Sana in Corpore Sano).

Giordano Ladies is a retail operation of Giordano Limited. With its first opening in Hong Kong in 1997, its business expands with more than 70 stores.
Giordano Ladies believes “to be truly beautiful is to have great style”. At Giordano Ladies, great style means bringing out and enhancing the inner beauty in every one of us through simplistic, modern classic, timeless clothes, clean and great personality. It’s what we really wear, what we put on when we don’t need to impress anybody, be anybody - that give us comfort.

Birkenstock is a renowned footwear brand from Germany, known for its simple yet highly functional and comfortable designs. Established in 1774, Birkenstock has built a strong reputation in the footwear industry thanks to its premium materials and proprietary footbed technology, which provides maximum support and protection for the feet. Birkenstock products not only offer exceptional comfort but also feature stylish designs that suit a wide range of looks, from casual wear to more refined outfits.

Gyu Shige – the long-standing Yakiniku restaurant chain has received a lot of favors from Japanese customers, with over 150 stores along across the famous cities of Asia.

Carrying the quintessence from Japanese cuisine to Vietnam, the restaurant uses premium beef and seafood imported directly, also the vegetables are directly planted at the restaurant’s farm in Da Lat with the purpose of bringing the experience of Yakiniku’s pure taste closer to Vietnamese gourmets.

GINSENG HOUSE is a health food import and distribute brand including functional food and normal food. GINSENG HOUSE is proud of supplying the best quality products with clearly source, be imported from Korea to customers.

About 20 years existing at Viet Nam market, GINSENG HOUSE is one of the first Korea functional food distributing supplier. By the effort and reputation during working, GINSENG HOUSE has been more and more expanding and developing, connecting with major partners to be able to supply products to all regions, contribute to the protection and improvement of health for all

Calvin Klein is one of the leading fashion brands in the world founded in 1968 by the designer of the same name Calvin Richard Klein. Calvin Klein always innovates and is at the forefront of technology and materials to bring customers, High-end fashion products with the best quality. American-inspired jeans, iconic Urban Chic, and Unisex Classic panties with bold advertising campaigns. Other product lines include CK Sport fashion line and CK Accessories: bags, belts, shoes, etc. All of them carry the seductive beauty of Calvin Klein's minimalist style. Au Chau Fashion and Cosmetic Company Limited (ACFC) is the exclusive distributor of Calvin Klein Jeans, Calvin Klein Underwear, and Calvin Klein Sports brands.

BOSS is a premium fashion brand under Hugo Boss AG, defined by a philosophy of modern confidence, ambition, and self-determination. The brand empowers individuals to express success on their own terms through refined, contemporary style. Offering menswear, womenswear, accessories, and fragrances, BOSS combines sharp tailoring with versatility and innovation. Rooted in quality craftsmanship and a forward-looking mindset, the brand balances timeless elegance with modern relevance, appealing to driven, style-conscious consumers worldwide.

Jewelry & Accessories BLOOM is the most loved Jewelry Brand in Japan and the "Only One" Jewelry Brand for you. Not just a piece to wear, but a jewelry that you want to wear, something so naturally a part of you.

Dim Tu Tac has always been about expanding new possibilities. The name itself carries the idea that anything is possible, a belief that has stayed with Dim Tu Tac from the beginning and continues to influence how they express Cantonese cuisine and dim sum through the craft of Cantonese gastronomy.

The Master Chefs and team take pride in making every part of the guest experience a little better each day. From the ingredients and the condiments we choose to the way each dish is prepared and presented, Dim Tu Tac cares about the small details that are often overlooked.

Their mission is to share the best of Cantonese cuisine with the world and show its sophistication as we continue to grow. They approach this with a relentless mindset, putting in the effort to improve continuously, even in the smallest ways.

G2000 is a Hong Kong–based office fashion brand and one of the well-known names in the global fashion industry. Constantly keeping up with modern fashion trends, the brand launches four collections—Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter—each year, perfectly timed for shopping seasons and catering to the style needs of sophisticated customers.

With a wide range of fabrics, diverse colors, and elegant, refined designs, G2000 has become a preferred choice for office professionals.

“Gong Cha” in Chinese means “Royal Tea” – a premium tea once reserved only for royalty. Today, Gong Cha aspires to bring the highest-quality tea to every customer, true to the meaning of its name. Since its establishment in Taiwan in 2006, Gong Cha has expanded rapidly with more than 1,500 stores across 19 countries. After years of continuous development, the brand has become a global favorite and one of the most trusted tea chains in the world.

ECCO is one of the world’s leading shoe brands combining style and comfort. ECCO’s success is built on products with a great fit and top-quality leathers. ECCO owns and manages every aspect of the value chain from tanneries and shoe manufacturing to wholesale and retail activities. ECCO’s products are sold in 88 countries from over 2,000 ECCO shops and more than 14,000 sales points. ECCO is family-owned, founded in Denmark in 1963, and employs more than 20,000 people worldwide.

No.1 Patisserie from Japan!

In December 1954, Châteraisé was born in the foothills of Mt. Fuji. Châteraisé is a No. 1 patisserie from Japan, with about 1000 stores in Japan and Asia. Châteraisé products are made from specially selected fresh ingredients such as water from Hakushu area, and milk and eggs delivered directly from contracted farms.

The wish to “make truly delicious products using natural ingredients to make people happy” has always stayed with Châteraisé as the number one principle.

storeDescription.markup:
Genki Sushi – a renowned sushi brand from Japan, established in 1968.

Serving customers swiftly through the Kousoku Train system, offering a fun and globally loved dining experience.

Established in 1999 by Mr. Yuji Hirota with the first store in Osaka, Japan, Beard Papa's is available at more than 400 locations worldwide and now in Vietnam. Beard Papa's always prioritize product quality as well as fine natural ingredients to deliver the best freshly made cream puffs and services to please our trusting consumers.

GIGI embodies femininity, elegance, and allure. Blending the free-spirited essence of Western aesthetics with the refined beauty of Asia, each GIGI design is crafted to offer both modernity and comfort for the casual lifestyle. As a member of the Maison RMI group with over 20 years of expertise in the luxury fashion industry, GIGI stands as a symbol of refined style and sophistication.

Two of our stores now proudly host the Annam Gourmet Lounge Café, a relaxed space to enjoy coffee with friends or a place to relax over a cheese platter and a glass of luscious wine. We are constantly innovating and evolving our business to ensure you experience the best in gourmet food and lifestyle.

DKNY, or Donna Karan New York, is a leading American fashion brand founded in 1989 by Donna Karan. DKNY has a full range of products for women, including apparel, accessories and footwear inspired by the energy and attitude of the New York city. The brand’s items are always innovative, satisfy the needs of women and are highly regarded for both quality and attractiveness.
Fila was founded in 1911 in Italy. Fila's products bring youthful, dynamic and comfortable style to its customers, thanks to which Fila has affirmed its position in the fashion world.
Chlo.D is a premium brand from South Korea, featuring luxurious designs and refined materials that provide customers with both comfort and an elegant, sophisticated feel.

Giordano, a popular fashion brand from Hong Kong established in 1981, s perceived as casual, simple and stylish. As a brand that produces high quality apparels that make people feel good and look great, Giordano understand that aside from products, customer service and good shopping environment play important roles in Giordano brand image.

Here at Annam Gourmet we are passionate about European Cuisine. From our humble beginnings as a small store, stocking just a handful of products, to a chain of stores across Vietnam, we have been providing the best in gourmet products for over 15 years.

Inspired by the distinct cheesy taste of Hokkaido dairy, and using a traditional recipe from Japan’s dairy heartland, it is not surprising that the famed ‘Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart’ has been a huge hit throughout Asia having successfully launched in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Brunei, Thailand, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Vietnam. After tireless taste testing using local ingredients, the Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart has succeeded in recreating a Hokkaido cheese flavour perfectly.

The Hokkaido Baked Cheese Tart is now set to become a Vietnamese favourite with 1st store in Saigon Centre.

Gogi House (Korean BBQ) is a famous restaurant chain with barbecued-at-the-table style which is specific for Korean cuisine. Gogi House focus on serving variety meat which is qualified & imported from USA/ AUS such as American Beef Ribseye, American Beef Ribs Finger… All are well - marinated to maintain sweet & fresh. Besides, customers can enjoy other delicious dish featuring Korean style : Bibimbap, Buckwheat noodles, Kimchi Soup & flavorful Hotpot.

A large space decorated with furniture made of natural wood of Gogi House create a friendly and warming atmosphere just like other vendor BBQ houses at Seoul, Korea. Well-training staffs with smiling face & good attitude also make customer feel relax & comfortable.

Women are always an endless source of inspiration that CHILENO brings in diverse collections ranging from dynamic youthful, gentle yet luxurious. Each design of CHILENO brings a meaningful message that women should always be beautiful, confident and happy.

Diptyque was founded in Saint-Germain, Paris, in 1961 by three artists—Desmond, Christian, and Yves—who shared a passion for creativity. The name “Diptyque” evokes a work of art in dialogue through two complementary panels. The brand harmonizes dreams and reality, nature and art, creating a universe of fragrance where imagination can roam freely.

In 1963, Diptyque introduced its first scented candles—creations that continue to captivate to this day. With a pioneering spirit, a sense of freedom, and exceptional craftsmanship, Diptyque continually reinterprets the past to shape the future.

HARNN was borne from a passionate craftsman’s heartfelt desire to enhance the way people care for themselves, doing so by creating high quality products using only natural ingredients and methods gathered from generations of Thai artisans before him. These humble origins and roots continue to inspire HARNN today and are embodied in all we do. From creations crafted by nature to immersive store experiences that engage the senses, HARNN seeks to transform how people nurture their mind, body and soul.

Born in 1928. An American lifestyle brand that delivers elegantly innovative product to extraordinary customers. Cole Haan designs for those who value every detail and every functional innovation—or those who seek a look that’s elegant and original. These are the same people who are using their minds, their means, and their creativity to shape a new world. People who are following their hearts to focus on the things that matter most. Cole Haan calls them Extraordinaries

Founded in Switzerland in 1980, HUBLOT is defined by its innovative concept, which began with the highly original combination of gold and rubber. This "Art of Fusion" stems from the imagination of its visionary Chairman, Jean-Claude Biver, and has been driven forward by CEO Ricardo Guadalupe since 2012. The release of the iconic, multi-award-winning Big Bang in 2005 paved the way for new flagship collections (Classic Fusion, Spirit of Big Bang), with complications ranging from the simple to the highly sophisticated, establishing the extraordinary DNA of the Swiss watchmaking house and ensuring its impressive growth. Keen to preserve its traditional and cutting-edge expertise, and guided by its philosophy to "Be First, Different and Unique", the Swiss watchmaker is consistently ahead of the curve, through its innovations in materials (scratch-resistant Magic Gold, ceramics in vibrant colours, sapphire), and the creation of Manufacture movements (Unico, Meca-10, Tourbillon). HUBLOT is fully committed to creating a Haute Horlogerie brand with a visionary future: a future which is fused with the key events and brands of our times (FIFA World CupTM, UEFA Champions LeagueTM, UEFA EUROTM) and the finest ambassadors our era has to offer (Kylian Mbappé, Usain Bolt, Pelé). Discover the HUBLOT universe at our network of boutiques located in key cities across the globe: Geneva, Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, Dubai, Tokyo, Singapore, Zürich, Vietnam.

Beauty Box was launched in 2018 with the companionship of exclusively distributed brands such as The Face Shop, Amuse, Club Clio, Dear Dahlia, Freshian, Klavuu, Banila Co and more than 150 famous HOT TREND brands from Europe to Asia. , it is impossible not to mention Shu uemura, Kiehl’s, Lancôme, OHUI, SUM:37, CAUDALIE, Beyond, NUXE, Laneige, Maybelline, L’Oreal, La Roche Posay, Vichy, Paula’s Choice, OFÉLIA, 3CE, Murad, M.O.I, Carslan…

As of this year, Beauty Box is a chain of stores that has grown to 28 large stores spanning across 3 major cities: Hanoi, Hai Phong, and Ho Chi Minh.

HLA was founded in 2002, and has focused on men’s apparel for nearly 20 years. HLA, known as men’s wardrobe, provides consumers with fashionable designs, high quality products and excellent shopping experiences. It follows global fashion trends closely to create products that cater to a broad range of tastes, aiming to provide a one-stop shopping zone that satisfies the demands of consumers for all occasions. Now HLA has more than 6600 stores distributed globally.

COACH - a global brand founded in 1941 in New York, is renowned for its modern luxury accessories such as gloves, hats, and scarves, as well as expertly crafted leather goods including wallets and handbags. Constantly evolving with the latest trends, Coach empowers you to shine through every refined detail and express your own sense of sophistication. Currently, authentic Coach products are exclusively distributed by Maison RMI.
Italy’s GEOX brand is world-renowned for its style, comfort and above all its technology and innovation, as the creator of the famous “shoes that breathe”.

Since 1969, customers have looked to Gap for updated, casual clothing and accessories that help them express their own personal sense of style. Today, Gap continues to be the best destination for wardrobe essentials such as T-shirts, hoodies, great-fitting pants and denim. What began as one brand has grown to include Gap, GapKids and babyGap.

Gap has become a cultural icon by offering clothing and accessories rooted in cool, confident and casual style to customers around the world.

The modern wardrobe as only Giorgio Armani could envision it, Armani Exchange embodies the youthful spirit of a new generation.

“I design for real people. I think of our customers all the time. There is no virtue whatsoever in creating clothing or accessories that are not practical” – Giorgo Armani.

BreadTalk is a premium bakery brand from Singapore, established in 2000 and has since expanded through franchising to many countries across Southeast Asia.

In Vietnam, BreadTalk Vietnam operates a nationwide network of stores, well-known for its wide range of sweet and savory breads, as well as custom-designed cakes for birthdays and special occasions.

With the slogan “Freshly Baked Everyday”, BreadTalk Vietnam is committed to delivering freshly baked products every day, made with high-quality imported ingredients to ensure exceptional taste and quality in every bite.

Currently, BreadTalk Vietnam has a strong presence in major cities such as Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Nha Trang, Hai Phong, and Hue, and aims to expand to more provinces across the country in the near future.

Founded in 1962 in Brazil, Havaianas is the world’s leading flip-flop brand, known for its simple design, durable rubber material, and vibrant colors that embody a carefree lifestyle. Beyond footwear, Havaianas has collaborated with top fashion houses like Dolce & Gabbana, Valentino, and global icons such as Disney, Netflix, and One Piece to create unique limited-edition collections.

Today, Havaianas is available in over 100 countries, selling more than 200 million pairs annually. In Vietnam, the brand operates 10 official stores, bringing the spirit of Brazilian joy and comfort to millions of customers nationwide.

Basta Hiro is established by Hiromi Yamada who possesses the first store in Tokyo with the desire to bring Italian cuisine widely to the local natives, also to every place in the world.

Original Napoli Pizza, Al Dente style Pasta, colorful Mediterranean delicacies transformed by the hands of a Japanese chef right at Basta Hiro in the heart of Saigon.

Himalaya is a chain of retail stores of products that meet all fragrance needs in all spaces, with many different types of products and scents, and products that support health care with natural fragrance!

MISSION

Help customers choose their favorite scents and have fun throughout the use process.

VISION

The destination for all your fragrance needs.

CORE VALUES

Trustworthy - Kind - Improved

HOKA® is one of the fastest-growing footwear and sports apparel brands in history. Born from the mountains, HOKA shoes offer an unprecedented combination of plush cushioning and optimal support, making every stride feel smoother. Every day, HOKA innovates in design and technology by collaborating with world champions, style icons, and everyday athletes. From the finish line to daily life, HOKA fans love the brand for its bold, unique style and its belief in the power of people to drive positive change. HOKA inspires the world to move, helping everyone "fly over the earth."

Highlands Coffee was born out of the pure passion for Vietnamese coffee. Originating as a packaged coffee business, in Hanoi, in 2000, we’ve quickly grown into a chain of well-known coffee shops that have been expanding throughout Vietnam and abroad since 2002. 

Over time we’ve become famous for consistently delivering delicious Vietnamese coffee in a modern and comfortable environment that reflects the appeal of modern Vietnamese life. Great cafe, great products and great service at an affordable price.

Beginning from manufacturer until now Century is standing strong as one of the biggest "breakthrough" retail-chain pharmacy and beauty with wide chain all over Indonesia. During 25 years experience, we get the love and belief of customers in Indonesia.

We respect the concept of “total health” called wellness. Customer’s total healthiness is Century commitment. Make sure that customer will get the right product with reasonable price. 
“Your wellness first. We are not saleman. We are trusted as health & skin expert."

Dsquared2 - a leading fashion house from Italy’s fashion capital. Founded in 1995, the brand quickly became a global icon loved by the youth for its bold, free-spirited, and distinctive style. Blending Canadian energy with Italian craftsmanship, Dsquared2 creates a unique aesthetic that stands out across generations. The brand is exclusively distributed in Vietnam by Maison RMI.

Qhome, established since 1997 at Saigon Centre in Ho Chi Minh city from a small shop specializing in homeware ceramic and porcelain, created from the need to share joy with the loved ones. Qhome is currently the distributor of well-known domestic and foreign brands for home use and professional use tableware such as Minh Long I, Cuong Phat, Wilmax, RAK, Noritake,...

Established in 1988, SJC always aims to become a prestigious and quality high-end jewelry brand. SJC jewelry that comes into the mind of customers is a product of trust, prestige and quality, worthy of the title of National brand.

SJC products are diverse with many types from popular to high-end.

SJC Jewelry - Masterpiece from the heart and creativity.

Established in 1992 in Europe, Miana quickly became one of the most popular fashion brands in Europe.

Miana’s collections are stylish, modern and minimalist, made with high quality material and designed to fit perfectly.

At Miana, we aim to bring our customers not only fashionable outfits but also comfort and confidence.

llaollao is a Spanish frozen yogurt brand founded in 2009 and now present in over 25 countries. Made from naturally fermented yogurt and paired with a wide variety of toppings, it offers a fresh, healthy, and flavorful experience. With the message “more feeling, more flavor,” llaollao encourages everyone to live lightly and enjoy every moment. Loved by all ages, especially young people, the brand stands out for its personalization and the joy found in every spoonful of yogurt.

The World of Diamonds (TGKC) is one of the leading brands in Vietnam specializing in diamonds and jewelry. To date, the company has a team of over 800 employees and a network of 100++ stores spanning across the entire country.

Since April 30, 2020, TGKC proudly became an official member of the DOJI Group."

Products:

- 100% natural diamonds have international certificate of GIA, IGI.

- With unique design and sophisticated quality to every detail, Diamond World is considered the preferred choice among the Jewelry loving clients with product lines FOR WOMEN (Ring, Earing, Pendant, Bracelet,...) FOR MEN (Diamond, Gemstone....), Wedding & Bridal (Proposal Rings, Couple Ring, Sets,...).

-Trust and Advocate of customer are the strength to Diamond World serve better.

Nike Inc, originally from Beaverton, Oregon, has been dominating the sportswear industry for decades now. From footwear to apparel, every Nike product is infused with technology that enhances athlete performance.

Nike Saigon Centre offers the latest Nike basketball gear but also provides trendy running and training equipment for both genders. The store staffs are dedicated Nike Athletes ready to share their passion and knowledge to every visitor.

Nike spirit could be summed up in one famous quote by Bill Bowerman co-founder of Nike: “If you have a body, you are an ATHLETE!”

PAUL, founded in 1889, offers a selection of country-style and fancy bread, viennoiserie (croissants, etc.) pastries, cakes and desserts, snacks and sandwiches to more than 5 million customers every month.

THE 350F: TASTE OF PASSION

Founded in 2018 from a deep passion for pastry, The 350F is dedicated to delivering high-quality, "Natural - Less Sweet" creations. In just six years, this online bakery has expanded into five elegant branches, each uniquely designed to offer an inviting experience. The 350F takes pride in its diverse range of products, including mini gift sets, Tiramisu in tin boxes, Thousand-layer Tarts, and its signature Mousse cakes, which have become a hallmark of the brand.

With unwavering enthusiasm, The 350F aims to provide every customer with a delightful and memorable experience.

PEDRO is a brand of footwear, handbags, and accessories for both men and women from Singapore. Established in 2005, PEDRO is now present in 19 countries, including Vietnam, with over 109 stores worldwide.

Founded in Munich in 1976, MCM is renowned for bold design, German craftsmanship, and a spirit of modern mobility. Celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026, the brand continues to evolve through its iconic Visetos motif, functional luxury philosophy, and cultural collaborations across music, art, and sport. Alongside innovation and craftsmanship, MCM is committed to sustainability through responsible sourcing, alternative materials, and circular design initiatives.

Founded in Kansas in 1889, Lee is a pioneering denim brand that embodies durability, authenticity, and freedom. The brand is instantly recognized by iconic details such as the Lazy S stitch and the Hair-on-Hide leather patch.

From its beginnings as practical workwear, Lee has become a global fashion symbol, celebrated for outstanding quality and versatile design. Today, Lee not only preserves its denim heritage but also embraces the spirit of modern generations—youthful, creative, and expressive—continuing to inspire through timeless craftsmanship and contemporary style.

POP MART is a rising global force in pop culture and entertainment, specializing in the production and distribution of art toys and collectibles, particularly Blind Box category. Founded in 2010, POP MART has rapidly grown to become one of the top international brands in the art toy industry in Asia, with a mission to Light up passion and bring joy.

From Switzerland to the world, Nespresso redefines how coffee is enjoyed at home - quick, clean and effortlessly delicious. With a wide range of blends and machines to suit every taste, making your perfect cup has never been easier.

Now at Saigon Centre - discover how great coffee begins with just one button.

THANN is a natural skincare and haircare brand from Thailand combining modern science with botanical extracts. Its key ingredient, Rice Bran Oil, is rich in Vitamin E and antioxidants, while Nano Shiso Extract enhances skin protection. THANN focuses on eco-friendly design and ethical production, earning awards like the Thailand Prime Minister’s Export Award and the Marie Claire Best Beauty Award. With stores in 18 countries, THANN represents sustainable luxury.

Born in Singapore, IRVINS has become dangerously addictive across Asia with its salted-egg fish skin and potato chips — crispy, rich, and impossible to stop once you start. Crafted with carefully selected ingredients and meticulous production, IRVINS delivers a premium snacking experience with a uniquely rich and refined salted-egg flavor. It’s more than just a snack — it’s a modern, captivating way to indulge.

With more than 30 types of cool ice-cream from only #30k, you can enjoy soft and smooth Gelato ice-creams with unique flavors such as: salted peanuts 🥜, pistachios 🌱, tiramisu 🍰, yogurt 🥛... as well as lovely bear paw pop ice-cream 🐾, cup pop ice-cream,...

L'Usine brings cosmopolitan Vietnamese lifestyle and design, creates lasting impressions, and curates a sense of discovery at Saigon Centre.

Founded in the United States in 1910 by Jesse Shwayder, Samsonite is renowned for its wide range of luggage, backpacks, bags, and travel accessories. Combining advanced technology with a premium, sophisticated design, Samsonite products are lightweight, durable, impact-resistant, and optimized for maximum capacity—meeting the needs of even the most discerning travelers. Present in over 118 countries, including Vietnam, all Samsonite products are backed by a global warranty at authorized service centers worldwide.

TUMI is a leading global lifestyle and travel accessories brand, delivering products of exceptional quality and performance that are trusted by travel enthusiasts around the world. TUMI continuously pursues sustainable design through its proprietary materials and its mission to create travel solutions for today and for the future.

The restaurant system – Sushi Hokkaido Sachi specializes in pure Sashimi, Sushi dishes the origin of the cherry blossom land combines with the freshest ingredients coming from Hokkaido’s ocean and neighboring areas.

Established 2001 in Japan.

JINS was founded over 20 years ago with a mission to provide functional, innovative, and lightweight eyewear for everyone at an accessible price. Every JINS frame is designed in Tokyo and carefully assembled with the spirit and passion of Japanese craftsmanship.

Founded in 1984 by Creative Director Evelyne Chetrite, Sandro has established itself as a global pioneer in the premium fashion segment. A true embodiment of the Parisian style legacy, the brand draws inspiration from the modern world, grounded in reality while infusing a fresh, bold perspective into contemporary trends.

Sandro has carved out a distinctive identity through its continuous pursuit of the perfect balance between creativity and authenticity. Femininity lies at the heart of every Sandro design, while the Sandro man exudes effortless sophistication, defined by impeccably tailored suits, oversized long coats and refined, thoughtfully crafted accessories.

OGAWA is a multinational wellness brand founded in 1996 and has been established in Vietnam since 2006. With more than 1,000 stores in over 80 countries, OGAWA has solidified its pioneering position in the health and wellness industry.

For nearly three decades, OGAWA has continuously innovated to deliver optimal relaxation and recovery experiences. All products are manufactured under strict quality standards, and several massage chair models have been researched and verified for their health benefits by the University of Malaysia(*).

(*) The results were conducted in collaboration with the University of Malaysia and published on March 31, 2024.

Established in 2010, MUJOSH is a pioneering fashion eyewear brand. Boldly combining unique elements and styles into design, this dedicated brand has an attitude of its own to encourage the young group to think out of the box and to show who they are. MUJOSH is loved by fashion icons and wearers around the world.

With six years' rapid development, over 700 MUJOSH specialty stores have been seen in high-end shopping malls and department stores as: Saigon Centre - Vietnam, Mainland China, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia and Australia, and MUJOSH stores are expected to open in Philippines, Canada, etc.

Opened since 2009, Kichi Kichi™ has been the leading conveyor hot pot restaurant chain in Vietnam. Its diversified and tasty dishes are served on the modern and unique conveyor belts inspired by the Kaiten model in Japan. With only one fixed price, diners then feel free to enjoy the unlimited number of high-quality dishes with 6 kinds of broth and over 100 types of food including USA beef chuck and tongue, Korean mushrooms, fresh vegetables and a variety of other handmade dishes.

With the slogan “Non-stop moving”, Kichi Kichi™ is committed to constant improvement and development so as to bring new breathes of freshness every day to its diners. In addition to bringing new dishes of special tastes, Kichi Kichi™ also hosts a number of significant activities for its customers’ new experiences.

Weekend Max Mara is born as the “life-style” line of the Max Mara Group, and it’s targeted to the Max Mara woman who likes to dress in an informal and casual way, but always chic at the same time, even in her free time. ATTITUDE “chic & free” are the key words that best represent Weekend Max Mara’s spirit and identity.

“Miyama” (美山) - Beautiful Mountain, born from an ambition to implant a truly modern Tokyo Restaurant Cafe into the midst of bustling Saigon.

From our grand desserts, inspired food, minimalist space, to the urban views through the glass windows, the whole concept of Miyama is designed to make you feel as if you’re sitting in Tokyo, watching the busy streets of Shibuya, to fulfill your senses at Miyama.

Following on from the success of its outpost in Hanoi, RIMOWA is delighted to announce a brand-new concept store in Ho Chi Minh City.

Located in Saigon Centre, the boutique sits within a landmark development on Le Loi Boulevard in the heart of the city’s business district. Surrounded by some of the world’s finest luxury brands, the strikingly minimalist concept store will offer the full range of RIMOWA designs, from its iconic grooved suitcases to the daily bags in the Never

Still and Personal collections. And, to ensure every suitcase lasts as long as possible, a dedicated in-store client care centre provides travellers with expert repairs to wheels, locks, and handles.

Born in 2009, Typo filled a gap in the market for unique,fun and affordable stationery. What started as a stationery brand, is now so much more. We have evolved our offering to include gifts, techware, décor and travel accessories. Established in 2006, Danh Gia Fashion is the exclusive distributor of the high-end fashion brand Lacoste in Vietnam, Cambodia, and Myanmar.

Guided by our mission of "Sustainable Development," Danh Gia aspires to accompany our valued customers on their journeys in life and work through the Lacoste brand in particular and the fashion industry in general.

OWNDAYS — a Japanese eyewear brand offering an easy pricing system starting from VND 1,580,000. All listed prices include prescription lenses, a one-year warranty for both frame and vision, along with a complimentary vision testing services.

Photo Objet is a brand-new Korean-style photobooth located at Saigon Centre, District 1, where you can freely pose and capture your most beautiful moments. Lush is a British company, founded in Poole (UK) in 1995 and an inventor, manufacturer and retailer of fresh handmade cosmetics, such as the fizzing Bath Bomb and solid Shampoo Bars, leading the beauty industry in combating over-packaging by developing products that can be sold “naked” to the consumer.

Today, Lush operates in over 50 countries with the ultimate goal is to leave the world Lusher than we found it.

  2. Participate in – rather than report on – the dialogue between sport and culture.

Located on the ground floor of the Saigon Centre. storeDescription.markup: Skechers is a well-known American fashion brand specializing in the design, development, and retail of footwear, apparel, and accessories for men, women, and children.
